sentences.en: He uses special audio equipment to record high-quality soundtracks.
sentences.zh: 他用特殊音频设备来录制高质量的 soundtrack。

sentences.en: The theater invested in new special audio equipment for better sound effects.
sentences.zh: 剧院投资购买了新的特殊音频设备以获得更好的音效。

sentences.en: She prefers to listen to music with her special audio equipment at home.
sentences.zh: 她更喜欢在家里用她的特殊音频设备听音乐。
